text.content:
Reapers harvest spiritual energy moments before death, when it is at its brightest.

SKILLS

Reaping · SL max 5

After a creature you can see loses Hit Points, if that creature is in Crisis and is not undead, you gain 1 Grave Point (you may hold up to (SL + 1) Grave Points at a time). When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you lose all your Grave Points; the first time this happens each scene, if you lost at least 1 Grave Point this way, your Hit Points become (SL × the number of Grave Points lost) instead of 0.

The Grave Speaks

You can always communicate with undead creatures. Once per scene, you may ask an undead creature one question; it is compelled to answer truthfully.

Cold Comfort · SL max 5

After you cause one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if at least one of those enemies is shaken and/or weak, you gain 1 Grave Point and recover (SL × 2) Mind Points.

Toll · SL max 5

When your spell deals damage to one or more enemies, you may spend 1 Grave Point and choose one of the following: choose one enemy damaged by the spell — the spell deals extra damage to each damaged enemy equal to (SL + that enemy's current number of status effects); or every enemy damaged by the spell suffers shaken after the spell resolves.

Corpse-Light

When you cast an offensive spell with a target of "One creature", you may spend 2 Grave Points: that spell instead targets every creature present in the scene — allies included — making one Magic Check compared against each Magic Defense separately. All damage dealt by the spell becomes dark and cannot change type.

RULES

Raising targets beasts, monsters and plants only — never humanoids. (House restriction, Unmasked.)
